# Approximately 54% of shots taken are misses and 46% of shots are made.

```{r Shot Outcome}
prop.table(table(train_df$outcome))
```

# Break groups by distance
```{r distance_df}
distance_df <- train_df |> 
  mutate(distance_group = cut(
    distance,
    breaks = c(0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, Inf),
    right = FALSE
    )
  )
```


# Distance group shot outcomes
```{r}
distance_df |>
  group_by(distance_group) |>
  summarise(
    shots = n(),
    make_rate = mean(outcome)
  ) 
```

# Creating Groups
```{r}
distance_summary <- train_df |>
  mutate(
    distance_group = cut(
      distance,
      breaks = c(0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, Inf),
      labels = c(
        "0-5 ft",
        "5-10 ft",
        "10-15 ft",
        "15-20 ft",
        "20-25 ft",
        "25-30 ft",
        "30+ ft"
      ),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(distance_group) |>
  summarise(
    shots = n(),
    make_rate = mean(outcome),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r Distance shot rate visual}
ggplot(
  distance_summary,
  aes(x = distance_group, y = make_rate, group = 1)
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Shot Make Rate by Distance",
    x = "Distance from basket",
    y = "Make rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Feature Engineering ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r Defender Distance}
train_df |>
  summarise(
    min_defdist = min(closestdefdist, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_defdist = median(closestdefdist, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_defdist = mean(closestdefdist, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_defdist = max(closestdefdist, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
train_df |>
  mutate(
    defdist_group = cut(
      closestdefdist,
      breaks = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, Inf),
      labels = c("0-2", "2-4", "4-6", "6-8", "8-10", "10+")
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(defdist_group) |>
  summarise(
    shots = n(),
    make_rate = mean(outcome)
  )
```

```{r}
defender_summary <- train_df |>
  mutate(
    defdist_group = cut(
      closestdefdist,
      breaks = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, Inf),
      labels = c(
        "0-2 ft",
        "2-4 ft",
        "4-6 ft",
        "6-8 ft",
        "8-10 ft",
        "10+ ft"
      ),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(defdist_group) |>
  summarise(
    shots = n(),
    make_rate = mean(outcome),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


## Train / Validation Split -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r Training Model}
train_model <- train_df |>
  mutate(
    three = as.factor(three),
    shottype = as.factor(shottype),
    gamestate = as.factor(gamestate)
  )
```


```{r Validation Set}
set.seed(123)

train_indices <- sample(
  seq_len(nrow(train_model)),
  size = 0.8 * nrow(train_model)
)

model_train <- train_model[train_indices, ]
model_valid <- train_model[-train_indices, ]
```

```{r Logistic Regression}
baseline_model <- glm(
  outcome ~
    distance +
    three +
    shottype +
    closestdefdist +
    gamestate +
    shotclock +
    dribblesbefore +
    shooterspeed +
    locationx +
    locationy,
  data = model_train,
  family = binomial()
)
```

```{r}
valid_predictions <- predict(
  baseline_model,
  newdata = model_valid,
  type = "response"
)
```

# Baseline logistic regression = 0.6447523

```{r Baseline Score}
epsilon <- 1e-15

valid_predictions <- pmin(
  pmax(valid_predictions, epsilon),
  1 - epsilon
)

log_loss <- -mean(
  model_valid$outcome * log(valid_predictions) +
    (1 - model_valid$outcome) * log(1 - valid_predictions)
)

log_loss
```

## Improved Logistic Regression -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r Improved Model with polynomials}
improved_model <- glm(
  outcome ~
    poly(distance, 2) +
    three +
    shottype +
    poly(closestdefdist, 2) +
    gamestate +
    poly(shotclock, 2) +
    dribblesbefore +
    shooterspeed +
    poly(locationx, 2) +
    poly(locationy, 2),
  data = model_train,
  family = binomial()
)

```

# Nonlinear Model did improve validation performance

```{r}
improved_predictions <- predict(
  improved_model,
  newdata = model_valid,
  type = "response"
)

improved_predictions <- pmin(
  pmax(improved_predictions, epsilon),
  1 - epsilon
)

improved_log_loss <- -mean(
  model_valid$outcome * log(improved_predictions) +
    (1 - model_valid$outcome) * log(1 - improved_predictions)
)

improved_log_loss
```

```{r Improved Model 2}
improved_model_2 <- glm(
```

```{r}
train_model <- train_model |>
  mutate(
    defdist_1sec = as.numeric(str_split(
      str_remove_all(closestdefapproach, "[{}]"),
      ","
    ) |> sapply(`[`, 1)),

    defdist_075sec = as.numeric(str_split(
      str_remove_all(closestdefapproach, "[{}]"),
      ","
    ) |> sapply(`[`, 2)),

    defdist_05sec = as.numeric(str_split(
      str_remove_all(closestdefapproach, "[{}]"),
      ","
    ) |> sapply(`[`, 3)),

    defdist_025sec = as.numeric(str_split(
      str_remove_all(closestdefapproach, "[{}]"),
      ","
    ) |> sapply(`[`, 4))
  )
```

```{r Defender Approaching Distances}
train_model |>
  select(
    closestdefapproach,
    defdist_1sec,
    defdist_075sec,
    defdist_05sec,
    defdist_025sec
  ) |>
  head(10)
```

```{r}
train_model <- train_model |>
  mutate(
    defender_approach = defdist_025sec - defdist_1sec
  )
```

# TRUE indicates that the defender moved closer as the shot was taken.

```{r}
train_model |>
  group_by(
    defender_approach < 0
  ) |>
  summarise(
    shots = n(),
    make_rate = mean(outcome),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)

train_indices <- sample(
  seq_len(nrow(train_model)),
  size = 0.8 * nrow(train_model)
)

model_train <- train_model[train_indices, ]
model_valid <- train_model[-train_indices, ]
```


```{r Improved Model 3}
improved_model_3 <- glm(
  outcome ~
    poly(distance, 2) +
    three +
    shottype +
    poly(closestdefdist, 2) +
    gamestate +
    poly(shotclock, 2) +
    dribblesbefore +
    shooterspeed +
    poly(locationx, 2) +
    poly(locationy, 2) +
    as.factor(num_contesters) +
    defender_approach,
  data = model_train,
  family = binomial()
)
```

# Adding defender_approach produced almost no additional improvement
# Validation log-loss ≈ 0.6403272

## XGBoost Model Development ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r XGBoost}
library(xgboost)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r Feature List Update}
xgb_features <- c(
  "distance",
  "three",
  "shottype",
  "closestdefdist",
  "gamestate",
  "shotclock",
  "dribblesbefore",
  "shooterspeed",
  "locationx",
  "locationy",
  "num_contesters"
)
```

```{r Converting data}
xgb_train_df <- model_train |>
  select(outcome, all_of(xgb_features))

xgb_valid_df <- model_valid |>
  select(outcome, all_of(xgb_features))
```

```{r Matrix Creation}
x_train <- model.matrix(
  outcome ~ . - 1,
  data = xgb_train_df
)

x_valid <- model.matrix(
  outcome ~ . - 1,
  data = xgb_valid_df
)
```

```{r XGBoost Data Object Creation}
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = x_train,
  label = xgb_train_df$outcome
)

dvalid <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = x_valid,
  label = xgb_valid_df$outcome
)
```

```{r Train first XGBoost Model}
set.seed(123)

xgb_model <- xgb.train(
  params = list(
    objective = "binary:logistic",
    eval_metric = "logloss",
    eta = 0.05,
    max_depth = 5,
    min_child_weight = 10,
    subsample = 0.8,
    colsample_bytree = 0.8
  ),
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = 300,
  watchlist = list(
    train = dtrain,
    validation = dvalid
  ),
  verbose = 1
)
```

```{r Calculating log-loss}
xgb_predictions <- predict(
  xgb_model,
  dvalid
)
```

```{r}
xgb_predictions <- pmin(
  pmax(xgb_predictions, epsilon),
  1 - epsilon
)

xgb_log_loss <- -mean(
  model_valid$outcome * log(xgb_predictions) +
    (1 - model_valid$outcome) * log(1 - xgb_predictions)
)

xgb_log_loss
```

# # Initial XGBoost validation log-loss = 0.6278

```{r}
evaluation_log <- attr(xgb_model, "evaluation_log")

best_row <- which.min(evaluation_log$validation_logloss)

best_iteration <- evaluation_log$iter[best_row]
best_score <- evaluation_log$validation_logloss[best_row]

best_iteration
best_score
```

```{r}
importance_matrix <- xgb.importance(
  model = xgb_model
)

importance_matrix

xgb.plot.importance(
  importance_matrix,
  top_n = 15
)
```

```{r}
depth_results <- data.frame(
  max_depth = numeric(),
  best_iteration = numeric(),
  logloss = numeric()
)

set.seed(123)

for (depth in c(3, 4, 5, 6)) {

  model_temp <- xgb.train(
    params = list(
      objective = "binary:logistic",
      eval_metric = "logloss",
      eta = 0.05,
      max_depth = depth,
      min_child_weight = 10,
      subsample = 0.8,
      colsample_bytree = 0.8
    ),
    data = dtrain,
    nrounds = 600,
    watchlist = list(
      train = dtrain,
      validation = dvalid
    ),
    early_stopping_rounds = 30,
    verbose = 0
  )

  eval_log <- attr(model_temp, "evaluation_log")

  best_row <- which.min(eval_log$validation_logloss)

  depth_results <- rbind(
    depth_results,
    data.frame(
      max_depth = depth,
      best_iteration = eval_log$iter[best_row],
      logloss = eval_log$validation_logloss[best_row]
    )
  )
}

depth_results
```

```{r}
expanded_log <- attr(
  xgb_expanded,
  "evaluation_log"
)

best_row <- which.min(
  expanded_log$validation_logloss
)

expanded_best_iteration <- expanded_log$iter[best_row]

expanded_best_iteration
```

```{r}
tuning_results <- data.frame(
  eta = numeric(),
  min_child_weight = numeric(),
  best_iteration = numeric(),
  logloss = numeric()
)

settings <- data.frame(
  eta = c(0.03, 0.03, 0.05, 0.05),
  min_child_weight = c(5, 10, 5, 10)
)

set.seed(123)

for (i in 1:nrow(settings)) {

  temp_model <- xgb.train(
    params = list(
      objective = "binary:logistic",
      eval_metric = "logloss",
      eta = settings$eta[i],
      max_depth = 6,
      min_child_weight = settings$min_child_weight[i],
      subsample = 0.8,
      colsample_bytree = 0.8
    ),
    data = dtrain_expanded,
    nrounds = 700,
    watchlist = list(
      train = dtrain_expanded,
      validation = dvalid_expanded
    ),
    early_stopping_rounds = 30,
    verbose = 0
  )

  eval_log <- attr(temp_model, "evaluation_log")

  best_row <- which.min(
    eval_log$validation_logloss
  )

  tuning_results <- rbind(
    tuning_results,
    data.frame(
      eta = settings$eta[i],
      min_child_weight = settings$min_child_weight[i],
      best_iteration = eval_log$iter[best_row],
      logloss = eval_log$validation_logloss[best_row]
    )
  )
}

tuning_results
```

# Building Final Training and Testing Matrices
```{r}
train_final <- train_df |>
  mutate(
    three = as.factor(three),
    shottype = as.factor(shottype),
    gamestate = as.factor(gamestate)
  )

test_final <- test_df |>
  mutate(
    three = factor(three, levels = levels(train_final$three)),
    shottype = factor(shottype, levels = levels(train_final$shottype)),
    gamestate = factor(gamestate, levels = levels(train_final$gamestate))
  )
```

```{r}
x_full <- model.matrix(
  ~ distance +
    three +
    shottype +
    closestdefdist +
    gamestate +
    shotclock +
    dribblesbefore +
    shooterspeed +
    locationx +
    locationy +
    num_contesters - 1,
  data = train_final
)

x_test <- model.matrix(
  ~ distance +
    three +
    shottype +
    closestdefdist +
    gamestate +
    shotclock +
    dribblesbefore +
    shooterspeed +
    locationx +
    locationy +
    num_contesters - 1,
  data = test_final
)
```

```{r}
x_full <- cbind(
  x_full,
  distcont1 = train_final$distcont1,
  distcont2 = train_final$distcont2,
  distcont3 = train_final$distcont3
)

x_test <- cbind(
  x_test,
  distcont1 = test_final$distcont1,
  distcont2 = test_final$distcont2,
  distcont3 = test_final$distcont3
)
```

```{r}

set.seed(123)

final_xgb_model <- xgb.train(
  params = list(

    max_depth = 6,
    min_child_weight = 10,
    subsample = 0.8,
    colsample_bytree = 0.8
  ),
  data = dfull,
  nrounds = 359,
  verbose = 0
)
```

# Final Predictions
```{r}
final_predictions <- predict(
  final_xgb_model,
  dtest
)
```


```{r}
length(final_predictions)
summary(final_predictions)

any(is.na(final_predictions))
any(final_predictions < 0)
any(final_predictions > 1)
```
